 [REPLAY] Stephen McKeon – Professor of Crypto Security Tokens (Capital Allocators, EP.69) 
 
 [REPLAY] Stephen McKeon – Professor of Crypto Security Tokens (Capital Allocators, EP.69) Jun 16, 2022

 Professor Stephen McKeon spent six years out of college working
in finance for venture-backed startups before returning to graduate
school and earning his PhD in finance in 2011. Blending his
interest and experience, Steve focuses his research on corporate
finance, M&A, security issuance, and most recently, crypto
assets, where he has become a leading academic authority in the
nascent area.

 Our conversation starts with Steve’s first job smack into the
teeth of the tech meltdown in 2000 and his subsequent roles at a
winery and a drone company.  We then turn to his work as an
academic in the world of crypto assets, walking through the thesis
for security tokens. 

 Steve presents a case for the future of security tokens that is
tangible and achievable.  Now that the noise from soaring
crypto currency prices has died down, we can learn a lot from Steve
about what blockchain technology may bring to investing in the
years ahead.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
